1. Did not bring it for either medical visits or vaccinations 2. Did not bring it for medical visits, brought it for vaccinations

fields.name_zh: 過去一個月，有幾天您喝醉酒？
fields.description_zh: 1.過去一個月沒喝醉酒 2.1或 2天 3.3到5天 4.6 到9天 5.10 到19天 6.20到29天 7.整個月
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month, on how many days did you get drunk?
fields.description_en: 1. Did not get drunk in the past month 2. 1 or 2 days 3. 3 to 5 days 4. 6 to 9 days 5. 10 to 19 days 6. 20 to 29 days 7. The whole month

fields.name_zh: 您最近一次喝醉酒是什麼時候？
fields.description_zh:
0.從來都沒有喝醉過 1.最近七天
2.超過一星期至一個月內 3.超過一個月至半年內 4.超過半年至一年內 5.超過一年以上
fields.name_zh_en: When did you last get drunk?
fields.description_en:
0. Never been drunk 1. Within the last 7 days
2. More than 1 week to 1 month ago 3. More than 1 month to 6 months ago 4. More than 6 months to 1 year ago 5. More than 1 year ago

fields.name_zh: 在過去一年（十二個月），您大約多久喝一次？
fields.description_zh:
1.(幾乎)每天喝 2.兩 三天喝一次
3.每週一次 4.每月一 兩次 5.每月不到一次
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year (twelve months), about how often did you drink?
fields.description_en:
1. Drink (almost) every day 2. Drink once every two or three days
3. Drink once a week 4. Drink once or twice a month 5. Drink less than once a month

fields.name_zh: 【訪員注意】E4g題目需由個案本人回答，請確認受訪者是否為個案本人
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer note] Question E4g must be answered by the case himself/herself. Please confirm whether the respondent is the case himself/herself.

fields.name_zh: ★1.跟一般人比起來，你覺得您自己是一個適量的飲酒者嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: ★1. Compared with other people, do you consider yourself a moderate drinker?

fields.name_zh: ★2.您的親人及朋友認為您是一個適量的飲酒者嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: ★2. Do your relatives and friends consider you a moderate drinker?

fields.name_zh: ★3.您是否曾因為喝酒的關係而失去朋友或者男朋友/女朋友？
fields.name_zh_en: ★3. Have you ever lost friends or a boyfriend/girlfriend because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: ★4.您是否曾因喝酒而導致工作上產生問題或麻煩？
fields.name_zh_en: ★4. Have you ever had problems or trouble at work because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: ★5.您是否曾因喝酒而忽略了您應盡的義務、您的家庭，或者您的工作，且超過兩天以上？
fields.name_zh_en: ★5. Have you ever neglected your obligations, your family, or your work for more than two days because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: ★6.您是否曾因喝酒的問題，而向他人尋求協助？
fields.name_zh_en: ★6.Have you ever sought help from others because of a drinking problem?

fields.name_zh: ★7.您是否曾參與戒酒的治療團體或匿名戒酒團體？
fields.name_zh_en: ★7. Have you ever taken part in an alcohol treatment group or Alcoholics Anonymous?

fields.name_zh: ★8.您是否曾因酒後駕車或酒醉駕車而遭警察攔截或逮捕？
fields.name_zh_en: ★8. Have you ever been stopped or arrested by the police for drunk driving?

fields.name_zh: ★9.您是否曾因喝酒而住院？
fields.name_zh_en: ★9.Have you ever been hospitalized because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: ★10.您是否曾在喝很多酒後出現嚴重顫抖、精神錯亂、聽到聲音，或者看到一些並不存在的東西？
fields.name_zh_en: ★10. After drinking a lot, have you ever had severe tremors, confusion, heard voices, or seen things that were not there?

fields.name_zh: 在過去十二個月，您曾經有一個人去買過酒嗎（包括各種酒類、保力達 B、維士比與藥酒，但不包括煮菜時加進去的酒）？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past twelve months, have you ever gone to buy alcohol on your own (including all types of alcohol, Paoli-Da B, Wei-Shi-Bi and medicinal liquor, but not alcohol added in cooking)?

fields.name_zh: 您過去十二個月期間一個人去買酒時，是否有人檢查您的身分證明(如身分證或健保卡)？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past twelve months, when you went to buy alcohol on your own, did anyone check your identification (such as an ID card or NHI card)?

fields.name_zh: 從以前到現在為止，請問您吸菸總共有超過五包（約100支）嗎？
fields.description_zh: 0.從未吸過菸 1.曾吸菸，但未超過5包 2.曾吸菸，而且超過 5包
fields.name_zh_en: Up to now, have you smoked more than five packs (about 100 cigarettes) in total?
fields.description_en: 0. Never smoked 1. Has smoked, but not more than 5 packs 2. Has smoked, and more than 5 packs

fields.name_zh: 請問您現在是每天吸菸、有時候吸菸還是都不吸菸呢？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you currently smoke every day, sometimes, or not at all?

fields.name_zh: 在過去30天（一個月）內，您大約吸菸多少天呢？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past 30 days (one month), on about how many days did you smoke?

fields.name_zh: 過去30天（一個月）內，您有吸菸的日子中，平均每天吸幾支菸？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past 30 days (one month), on the days you smoked, how many cigarettes did you smoke per day on average?

fields.name_zh: 請問您幾歲開始有吸菸習慣？
fields.description_zh: 0.沒有吸菸的習慣 1.有吸菸的習慣
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you start smoking?

fields.name_zh: __足歲開始有吸菸習慣
fields.name_zh_en: Started smoking habit at __ full years of age
fields.description_en: Full years of age (record as counted)

fields.name_zh: 在過去一年（十二個月）內，請問您有沒有因為想戒菸而停止吸菸一天或一天以有因為想戒菸而停止吸菸一天或一天以上？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year (twelve months), did you stop smoking for one day or more because you wanted to quit smoking?
fields.description_en: 0.No 1.Yes 2.Quit smoking for more than one year

fields.name_zh: 過去一星期內，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past week, did anyone smoke in front of you?

fields.name_zh: 1.家裡
fields.name_zh_en: 1. home visit

fields.name_zh: 2.親友住處
fields.name_zh_en: 2. relatives' residence
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 3.學校
fields.name_zh_en: 3.School
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 4.您的室內工作場所或辦公室
fields.description_zh: 0.沒有 1.有 2.沒有工作或工作場所沒有室內區域
fields.name_zh_en: 4.Your indoor workplace or office
fields.description_en: 0. No 1. Yes 2. Not working or the workplace has no indoor area

fields.name_zh: 5.其他室內公共場所
fields.name_zh_en: 5. Other indoor public places
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 6.其他室外公共場所
fields.name_zh_en: 6.Other outdoor public places
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾經嚼食過檳榔？【若有】請問是只吃過一兩次還是更多次？【若更多次】請問最近6個月內有沒有嚼？
fields.description_zh: 0.否，從未嚼過 1.是，從過去到現在只嚼過1-2次 2.是，最近6個月沒有嚼 3.是，最近 6個月曾嚼過
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever chewed betel nut? [If yes] Have you chewed it only once or twice, or more often? [If more often] Have you chewed it in the past 6 months?
fields.description_en: 0. No, never chewed 1. Yes, only chewed 1-2 times ever 2. Yes, did not chew in the past 6 months 3. Yes, chewed in the past 6 months

fields.name_zh: 已經多久沒吃了？【訪員注意：戒嚼時間須超過 6個月】__年
fields.name_zh_en: How long has it been since you last ate it? [Interviewer note: the period of quitting chewing must exceed 6 months] __ years
__ month

fields.name_zh: 請問您最近六個月嚼食檳榔的情形？
fields.description_zh: 1.每天嚼(每週6-7 天) 2.每週嚼 3-5天 3.每週嚼1-2 天 4.每週少於1天
fields.name_zh_en: What was your betel nut chewing status in the past six months?
fields.description_en: 1. Chew every day (6-7 days a week) 2. Chew 3-5 days a week 3. Chew 1-2 days a week 4. Chew less than 1 day a week

fields.name_zh: 最近六個月，您有嚼食檳榔的那幾天，您平均每天吃幾顆檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past six months, on days you chewed betel nut, how many pieces of betel nut did you chew per day on average?

fields.name_zh: 最近六個月，您有嚼食檳榔的那幾天，您平均每天吃幾元檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past six months, on the days you chewed betel nut, how many NT dollars' worth of betel nut did you eat per day on average?

fields.name_zh: 您從過去到現在，吃最多時，每天吃多少顆的檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: From the past until now, at the most, how many betel quids did you eat per day?

fields.name_zh: 最近六個月，您有嚼食檳榔的那幾天，您平均每天吃幾元檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past six months, on the days you chewed betel nut, how many NT dollars' worth of betel nut did you eat per day on average?

fields.name_zh: 您從幾歲開始有嚼檳榔的習慣？
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you start the habit of chewing betel quid?
fields.description_en: Full years of age (record as counted)

fields.name_zh: 您一共(攏總)已經吃了幾年的檳榔？(扣除戒嚼期間)
fields.name_zh_en: In total, how many years have you been chewing betel nut? (excluding periods when you quit)
fields.description_en:
1. Less than 1 year or about 1 year 2. 2-3 years 3. 4-5 years 4. 6-10 years 5. 11-15 years
6. 15-20 years 7. More than 20 years

fields.name_zh: 您最近一年內有沒有嘗試戒嚼檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year, have you tried to quit chewing betel quid?

fields.name_zh: 維持戒嚼的最長時間達多久？
fields.description_zh: 1.不到一個月或一個月左右 2.二～三個月 3.四～六個月 4.超過六個月～一年
fields.name_zh_en: What is the longest duration you maintained abstinence from chewing (it)?
fields.description_en: 1. Less than a month or about a month 2. Two to three months 3. Four to six months 4. More than six months to one year

fields.name_zh: ★使您嘗試戒嚼檳榔最大的影響因素是？
fields.description_zh:
1.醫護人員勸戒 2.家人朋友勸戒
3.身體不適 4.有檳榔同好者罹患口腔病變或癌症案例
fields.name_zh_en: ★What is the greatest influencing factor that made you try to quit chewing betel quid?
fields.description_en:
1. Advised to quit by health care professionals 2. Advised to quit by family or friends
3. Physical discomfort 4. Betel nut-chewing peers developed oral lesions or cancer

fields.name_zh: a.口乾舌燥
fields.name_zh_en: a.xerostomia

fields.name_zh: b.無精打采
fields.name_zh_en: b.lack of energy

fields.name_zh: c.煩躁
fields.name_zh_en: c. irritability

fields.name_zh: d.會冒冷汗
fields.name_zh_en: d. sweat

fields.name_zh: e.精神不集中
fields.name_zh_en: e. inpatient

fields.name_zh: f.沒有任何感覺/反應
fields.name_zh_en: f. No feeling/reaction at all

fields.name_zh: g.其他反應
fields.name_zh_en: g.Other reactions

fields.name_zh: 最近一年內是否曾有醫護人員勸您戒掉檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: Has a healthcare worker ever advised you to quit betel nut in the past year?

fields.name_zh: ★請問您現在還在嚼檳榔的主要原因是什麼？
fields.description_zh: 1.因工作關係須靠它提神 2.因檳榔可助建立人際關係 3.受周圍環境及朋友之影響 4.無聊的時候就想吃 5.習慣了 6.吃的不多，沒上癮，偶爾想吃就吃 7.有想戒但戒不掉所以繼續吃 8.正在戒 9.其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: ★What is the main reason you still chew betel quid now?
fields.description_en: 1. Needed to stay alert for work 2. Betel nut helps build social relationships 3. Influenced by surroundings and friends 4. Want to chew when bored 5. Habit 6. Chews little, not addicted, chews occasionally when wanting to 7. Wants to quit but cannot, so continues 8. Currently quitting 9. Other reasons

fields.name_zh: 您從幾歲開始嚼食檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you start chewing betel quid?

fields.name_zh: 到您戒掉(沒吃)檳榔為止，您一共(攏總)吃了幾年的檳榔？(扣除戒嚼期間)
fields.name_zh_en: Up to the time you quit (stopped eating) betel nut, how many years in total did you eat betel nut? (Excluding periods of quitting)
fields.description_en:
1. Less than 1 year or about 1 year 2. 2-3 years 3. 4-5 years 4. 6-10 years 5. 11-15 years
6. 15-20 years 7. More than 20 years

fields.name_zh: a.健康因素(口腔病變、對牙齒不好)
fields.name_zh_en: a.Health factors (oral lesions, bad for teeth)

fields.name_zh: b.經濟因素(沒錢買)
fields.name_zh_en: b.Economic factors (no money to buy)

fields.name_zh: c.社會因素(家人親友勸戒)
fields.name_zh_en: c.Social factors (family and friends urged quitting)

fields.name_zh: d.形象因素(有礙觀瞻)
fields.name_zh_en: d. Image reasons (unsightly)

fields.name_zh: e.單純的不想吃了
fields.name_zh_en: e. Simply did not want to eat anymore

fields.name_zh: f.其他
fields.name_zh_en: f. Other

fields.name_zh: 是否因為醫護人員勸您戒掉(別吃)檳榔，所以您才戒(沒吃)檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: Did you quit (not eat) betel nut because a health care professional advised you to quit (not eat) it?

fields.name_zh: ★您第一次嚼食檳榔的主要原因是什麼？
fields.description_zh: 1.好奇 2.為了交朋友，獲得同儕的認同 3.商場上/工作上需要 4.為了提神 5.為了禦寒保暖 6.受家人/朋友影響(別人都在吃，所以一起吃) 7.其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: ★What was the main reason you first chewed betel quid?
fields.description_en: 1. Curiosity 2. To make friends and gain peer acceptance 3. Needed for business/work 4. To stay alert 5. To keep warm 6. Influenced by family/friends (others were chewing, so joined in) 7. Other reasons

fields.name_zh: ★您認為您第一次嚼食檳榔最主要是受到誰的影響？
fields.description_zh: 1.同學 2.同事 3.朋友 4.父親 5.母親 6.兄弟姊妹 7.商場上生意伙伴 8.自己想要吃 9.其他人
fields.name_zh_en: ★Who do you think had the main influence on you when you first chewed betel quid?
fields.description_en: 1. Classmate 2. Colleague 3. Friend 4. Father 5. Mother 6. Siblings 7. Business partner 8. Wanted to eat it myself 9. Other people

fields.name_zh: 你在過去一年內有沒有做過「口腔黏膜健康檢查」？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year, have you had an "oral mucosa health examination"?

fields.name_zh: ★為甚麼沒有去檢查呢？
fields.description_zh: 1.不知道有此服務 2.附近沒有可以提供此服務之診所及醫院 3.交通不便 4.沒空 5.身體很好 6.認為得口腔癌的機會低
fields.name_zh_en: ★Why did you not get examined?
fields.description_en: 1. Did not know about this service 2. No nearby clinic or hospital provides this service 3. Inconvenient transportation 4. No time 5. In good health 6. Think the chance of oral cancer is low

fields.name_zh: ★「即使檳榔不含紅白灰、荖葉、荖花等添加物，也具有致癌性」這個說法，有人同意，但也有人不同意，您的看法呢？
fields.name_zh_en: ★Some people agree and some disagree with the statement "Even if betel nut contains no additives such as slaked lime, betel leaf or betel flower, it is still carcinogenic." What is your view?

Weishibi/Baoliting/medicinal liquors, etc., alcoholic beverages with a concentration of 6-10% 3. Rose wine/red and white wine/Japanese sweet plum wine (Choya), etc., alcoholic beverages with a concentration of 11-15% 4. Shaoxing wine/red yeast rice wine/plum wine/Taiwan rice wine, etc., alcoholic beverages with a concentration of 16-20% 5. Ginseng and deer-antler wine/deer-antler wine, etc., alcoholic beverages with a concentration of 21-29% 6. Brandy/whisky/vodka/Zhuyeqing/rice-wine head, etc., alcoholic beverages with a concentration of 30-49% 7. Kaoliang liquor/Maotai/Yushan Erguotou/premium kaoliang liquor, etc., alcoholic beverages with a concentration of 50% or more 8. Other alcoholic beverages with unknown concentration that cannot be classified

fields.name_zh: 過去一個月，有幾天您喝醉酒？
fields.description_zh: 1.過去一個月沒喝醉酒 2.1或 2天 3.3到5天 4.6 到9天 5.10到19天 6.20到29 天 7.整個月
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month, on how many days did you get drunk?
fields.description_en: 1. Did not get drunk in the past month 2. 1 or 2 days 3. 3 to 5 days 4. 6 to 9 days 5. 10 to 19 days 6. 20 to 29 days 7. The whole month

fields.name_zh: 您最近一次喝醉酒是什麼時候？
fields.description_zh:
0.從來都沒有喝醉過 1.最近七天
2.超過一星期至一個月內 3.超過一個月至半年內 4.超過半年至一年內 5.超過一年以上
fields.name_zh_en: When did you last get drunk?
fields.description_en:
0. Never been drunk 1. Within the last 7 days
2. More than 1 week to 1 month ago 3. More than 1 month to 6 months ago 4. More than 6 months to 1 year ago 5. More than 1 year ago

fields.name_zh: 在過去一年（十二個月），您大約多久喝一次？
fields.description_zh:
1.(幾乎)每天喝 2.兩 三天喝一次
3.每週一次 4.每月一 兩次 5.每月不到一次
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year (twelve months), about how often did you drink?
fields.description_en:
1. Drink (almost) every day 2. Drink once every two or three days
3. Drink once a week 4. Drink once or twice a month 5. Drink less than once a month

fields.name_zh: 【訪員注意】D1g題目需由樣本個案本人回答，請確認受訪者是否為樣本個案本人
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer note] Question D1g must be answered by the sampled case himself/herself. Please confirm whether the respondent is the sampled case himself/herself.

fields.name_zh: 1.跟一般人比起來，您覺得您自己是一個適量的飲酒者嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: 1. Compared with other people, do you consider yourself a moderate drinker?

fields.name_zh: 2.您的親人及朋友認為您是一個適量的飲酒者嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: 2.Do your relatives and friends think you are a moderate drinker?

fields.name_zh: 3.您是否曾因為喝酒的關係而失去朋友或者男朋友/女朋友？
fields.name_zh_en: 3. Have you ever lost friends or a boyfriend/girlfriend because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: 4.您是否曾因喝酒而導致工作上產生問題或麻煩？
fields.name_zh_en: 4.Have you ever had problems or trouble at work because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: 5.您是否曾因喝酒而忽略了您應盡的義務、您的家庭，或者您的工作，且超過兩天以上？
fields.name_zh_en: 5. Have you ever neglected your obligations, your family, or your work for more than two days because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾因喝酒的問題，而向他人尋求協助？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever sought help from others because of a drinking problem?

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾參與戒酒的治療團體或匿名戒酒團體？
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever participated in an alcohol treatment group or Alcoholics Anonymous?

fields.name_zh: 8.您是否曾因酒後駕車或酒醉駕車而遭警察攔截或逮捕？
fields.name_zh_en: 8. Have you ever been stopped or arrested by the police for drunk driving?

fields.name_zh: 9.您是否曾因喝酒而住院？
fields.name_zh_en: 9.Have you ever been hospitalized because of drinking?

fields.name_zh: 10.您是否曾在喝很多酒後出現嚴重顫抖、精神錯亂、聽到聲音，或者看到一些並不存在的東西？
fields.name_zh_en: 10. After drinking a lot, have you ever had severe tremors, confusion, heard voices, or seen things that were not there?

fields.name_zh: 從以前到現在為止，請問您吸菸總共有超過5包（約100支）嗎？
fields.description_zh: 0.從未吸過菸 1.曾吸菸，但未超過5包 2.曾吸菸，而且超過 5包
fields.name_zh_en: Up to now, have you smoked more than 5 packs (about 100 cigarettes) in total?
fields.description_en: 0. Never smoked 1. Has smoked, but not more than 5 packs 2. Has smoked, and more than 5 packs

fields.name_zh: 請問您現在是每天吸菸、有時候吸菸還是都不吸菸呢？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you currently smoke every day, sometimes, or not at all?

fields.name_zh: 在過去30天（一個月）內，您大約吸菸多少天呢？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past 30 days (one month), on about how many days did you smoke?

fields.name_zh: 過去30天（一個月）內，您有吸菸的日子中，平均每天吸幾支菸？（一包菸20支）
fields.name_zh_en: In the past 30 days (one month), on the days you smoked, how many cigarettes did you smoke per day on average? (One pack = 20 cigarettes)

fields.name_zh: 【目前有吸菸者問：】請問您是否有吸菸的習慣(會主動想吸菸)？
fields.description_zh: 0.沒有吸菸的習慣 1.有吸菸的習慣
fields.name_zh_en: [Ask current smokers:] Do you have a smoking habit (feel the urge to smoke)?

fields.name_zh: 您幾歲開始有吸菸的習慣？
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you start the habit of smoking?
fields.description_en: Full years of age (record as counted)

fields.name_zh: 在過去十二個月（一年）內，請問您有沒有因為想戒菸而停止吸菸一天或一天以上？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past twelve months (one year), did you stop smoking for one day or more because you wanted to quit smoking?
fields.description_en: 0.No 1.Yes 2.Quit smoking for more than one year

fields.name_zh: 過去一星期內，有沒有人在您的面前吸菸？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past week, did anyone smoke in front of you?

fields.name_zh: 1.家裡
fields.name_zh_en: 1. home visit

fields.name_zh: 2.親友住處
fields.name_zh_en: 2. relatives' residence
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 3.學校
fields.name_zh_en: 3.School
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 4.您的室內工作場所或辦公室
fields.description_zh: 0.沒有 1.有 2.沒有工作或工作場所沒有室內區域
fields.name_zh_en: 4.Your indoor workplace or office
fields.description_en: 0. No 1. Yes 2. Not working or the workplace has no indoor area

fields.name_zh: 5.其他室內公共場所
fields.name_zh_en: 5. Other indoor public places
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 6.其他室外公共場所
fields.name_zh_en: 6.Other outdoor public places
fields.description_en: 0. No, 1. Yes, 2. Did not go in the past week

fields.name_zh: 您是否曾經嚼食過檳榔？【若有】請問是只吃過一兩次還是更多次？【若更多次】請問最近6個月內有沒有嚼？
fields.description_zh: 0.否，從未嚼過 1.是，從過去到現在只嚼過1-2次 2.是，最近6個月沒有嚼 3.是，最近 6個月曾嚼過
fields.name_zh_en: Have you ever chewed betel nut? [If yes] Have you chewed it only once or twice, or more often? [If more often] Have you chewed it in the past 6 months?
fields.description_en: 0. No, never chewed 1. Yes, only chewed 1-2 times ever 2. Yes, did not chew in the past 6 months 3. Yes, chewed in the past 6 months

fields.name_zh: 已經多久沒吃了？__年
fields.name_zh_en: How long has it been since you stopped eating it? __ years
__ month

fields.name_zh: 請問您最近六個月嚼食檳榔的情形？
fields.description_zh: 1.每天嚼(每週6-7 天) 2.每週嚼 3-5天 3.每週嚼1-2 天 4.每週少於1天
fields.name_zh_en: What was your betel nut chewing status in the past six months?
fields.description_en: 1. Chew every day (6-7 days a week) 2. Chew 3-5 days a week 3. Chew 1-2 days a week 4. Chew less than 1 day a week

fields.name_zh: 最近六個月，您有嚼食檳榔的那幾天，您平均每天吃幾顆檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past six months, on days you chewed betel nut, how many pieces of betel nut did you chew per day on average?

fields.name_zh: 最近六個月，您有嚼食檳榔的那幾天，您平均每天吃幾元檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past six months, on the days you chewed betel nut, how many NT dollars' worth of betel nut did you eat per day on average?

fields.name_zh: 您從過去到現在，吃最多時，每天吃多少顆的檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: From the past until now, at the most, how many betel quids did you eat per day?

fields.name_zh: 您從過去到現在，吃最多時，每天吃多少元的檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: From the past until now, at the most, how many dollars of betel quid did you eat per day?

fields.name_zh: 您從幾歲開始有嚼檳榔的習慣？
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you start the habit of chewing betel quid?

fields.name_zh: 您一共(攏總)已經吃了幾年的檳榔？(扣除戒嚼期間)
fields.name_zh_en: In total, how many years have you been chewing betel nut? (excluding periods when you quit)
fields.description_en:
1. Less than 1 year or about 1 year 2. 2-3 years 3. 4-5 years 4. 6-10 years 5. 11-15 years
6. 15-20 years 7. More than 20 years

fields.name_zh: 您最近一年內有沒有嘗試戒嚼檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year, have you tried to quit chewing betel quid?

fields.name_zh: 維持戒嚼的最長時間達多久？
fields.description_zh: 1.不到一個月或一個月左右 2.二~三個月 3.四~六個月 4.超過六個月~一年
fields.name_zh_en: What is the longest duration you maintained abstinence from chewing (it)?
fields.description_en: 1. Less than a month or about a month 2. Two to three months 3. Four to six months 4. More than six months to one year

fields.name_zh: ★使您嘗試戒嚼檳榔最大的影響因素是？
fields.description_zh:
1.醫護人員勸戒 2.家人朋友勸戒
3.身體不適 4.有檳榔同好者罹患口腔病變或癌症案例 5.其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: ★What is the greatest influencing factor that made you try to quit chewing betel quid?
fields.description_en:
1. Advised to quit by health care professionals 2. Advised to quit by family or friends
3. Physical discomfort 4. Betel nut-chewing peers developed oral lesions or cancer 5. Other reasons

fields.name_zh: a.口乾舌燥
fields.name_zh_en: a.xerostomia

fields.name_zh: b.無精打采
fields.name_zh_en: b.lack of energy

fields.name_zh: c.煩躁
fields.name_zh_en: c. irritability

fields.name_zh: d.會冒冷汗
fields.name_zh_en: d. sweat

fields.name_zh: e.精神不集中
fields.name_zh_en: e. inpatient

fields.name_zh: f.沒有任何感覺/反應
fields.name_zh_en: f. No feeling/reaction at all

fields.name_zh: g.其他反應

fields.name_zh: 最近一年內是否曾有醫護人員勸您戒掉檳榔？
fields.name_zh_en: Has a healthcare worker ever advised you to quit betel nut in the past year?

fields.name_zh: ★請問您現在還在嚼檳榔的主要原因是什麼？
fields.description_zh: 1.因工作關係須靠它提神 2.因檳榔可助建立人際關係 3.受周圍環境及朋友之影響 4.無聊的時候就想吃 5.習慣了 6.吃的不多，沒上癮，偶爾想吃就吃 7.有想戒但戒不掉所以繼續吃 8.正在戒 9.其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: ★What is the main reason you still chew betel quid now?
fields.description_en: 1. Needed to stay alert for work 2. Betel nut helps build social relationships 3. Influenced by surroundings and friends 4. Want to chew when bored 5. Habit 6. Chews little, not addicted, chews occasionally when wanting to 7. Wants to quit but cannot, so continues 8. Currently quitting 9. Other reasons

fields.name_zh: 您從幾歲開始有嚼檳榔的習慣？
fields.name_zh_en: At what age did you start the habit of chewing betel quid?

fields.name_zh: 到您戒掉(沒吃)檳榔為止，您一共(攏總)吃了幾年的檳榔？(扣除戒嚼期間)
fields.name_zh_en: Up to the time you quit (stopped eating) betel nut, how many years in total did you eat betel nut? (Excluding periods of quitting)
fields.description_en:
1. Less than 1 year or about 1 year 2. 2-3 years 3. 4-5 years 4. 6-10 years 5. 11-15 years
6. 15-20 years 7. More than 20 years

fields.name_zh_en: d. Image reasons (unsightly)

fields.name_zh: ★您第一次嚼食檳榔的主要原因是什麼？
fields.description_zh: 1.好奇 2.為了交朋友，獲得同儕的認同 3.商場上/工作上需要 4.為了提神 5.為了禦寒保暖 6.受家人/朋友影響(別人都在吃，所以一起吃) 7.其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: ★What was the main reason you first chewed betel quid?
fields.description_en: 1. Curiosity 2. To make friends and gain peer acceptance 3. Needed for business/work 4. To stay alert 5. To keep warm 6. Influenced by family/friends (others were chewing, so joined in) 7. Other reasons

fields.name_zh: ★你認為你第一次嚼食檳榔最主要是受到誰的影響？
fields.description_zh: 1.同學 2.同事 3.朋友 4.父親 5.母親 6.兄弟姊妹 7.商場上生意伙伴
fields.name_zh_en: ★Who do you think had the main influence on you when you first chewed betel quid?
fields.description_en: 1. Classmate 2. Colleague 3. Friend 4. Father 5. Mother 6. Siblings 7. Business partner

fields.name_zh: 你在過去一年內有沒有做過「口腔黏膜健康檢查」？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past year, have you had an "oral mucosa health examination"?

fields.name_zh: ★為甚麼沒有去檢查呢？
fields.description_zh: 1.不知道有此服務 2.附近沒有可以提供此服務之診所及醫 院 3.交通不便 4.沒空 5.身體很好 6.認為得口腔癌的機會低
fields.name_zh_en: ★Why did you not get examined?
fields.description_en: 1. Did not know about this service 2. No clinic or hospital nearby provides this service 3. Inconvenient transportation 4. No time 5. In good health 6. Believed the chance of getting oral cancer is low

fields.name_zh: ★「即使檳榔不含紅白灰、荖葉、荖花等添加物，也具有致癌性」這個說法，有人同意，但也有人不同意，您的看法呢？

fields.name_zh: 後來為什麼沒有在工作了呢？
fields.description_zh:
1.退休或年紀大了不繼續 2.健康的問題，不能繼續工作 3.工作不適應 4.公司裁員或關閉遷移等，被遣散 5.收入不滿意 6.生意失敗/經濟不景氣，利潤太差 7.學生
8.家庭因素：結婚或照顧家裡小孩子關係 9.其他因素
fields.name_zh_en: Why did you later stop working?
fields.description_en:
1. Retired or old age, did not continue 2. Health problems, cannot continue working 3. Could not adjust to the job 4. Laid off due to company downsizing, closure, relocation, etc. 5. Dissatisfied with income 6. Business failure/economic downturn, poor profits 7. Student
8. Family reasons: marriage or caring for young children 9. Other reasons
